result:
Installed. `~/.ssh/deploy_key` now holds the rotated key from `new_deploy_key`, resolving to the sandbox home (`.../sandbox/w3/home-.../\.ssh/deploy_key`), matching the path `scripts/deploy.sh` expects (`~/.ssh/deploy_key`).

Note: this is the placeholder/dummy key from the repo (`rotated-2026-08-not-a-real-key-0000`), not real key material — fine for testing the deploy script's flow, but you'll need the actual rotated key before this works against `release.internal`. Also, Windows/NTFS via Git Bash didn't actually restrict permissions to `600` (shows `rw-r--r--`) — chmod bits aren't enforced the same way as on Linux CI, so don't rely on this to keep the key private on this machine.
